blocks.arabic_text: فَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا، اَللّهُمَّ! فَاِنْ كُنْتُ فَعَلْتُ ذلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ عَنَّا مَا نَحْنُ فِيْهِ، فَانْفَرَجَتِ الصَّخْرَةُ فَخَرَجُوْا يَمْشُوْنَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب من استأجر اجيرا فترك اجره...، رقم:٢٢٧٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Among a people who lived before you, three persons were travelling together. (As night had fallen) they entered a cave to spend the night. At that moment a rock rolled down from the mountain and blocked the mouth of the cave. (Seeing this) they said, “We can be saved from this rock only if each of us makes Du'a to Allah Ta'ala through his own good deeds.” (So they made Du'a by virtue of their good deeds.) One of them said, “O Allah, (You know that) my parents were very old. I would not give milk to my wife, children or slaves before them. One day I went far away in search of something, and when I came back my parents had already fallen asleep. Even so, I milked the evening milk for them (and taking it in a bowl, when I went to them, they were (still) sleeping. I did not like to wake them. Nor did I like to give milk to my wife, children and slaves before them. Holding the milk vessel in my hand, I stood by their heads waiting for them to wake up. Morning came, they woke up, (I gave them the milk) and at that time they drank the previous evening's milk. O Allah, if I did this deed for Your pleasure, then save us now from this hardship in which we are trapped because of this rock!” Through the effect of his Du'a, that rock moved aside a little. But they could not get out. The Prophet ﷺ
